section_1_tools.title: Letter Visitors

section_1_tools.title: Motionflare
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: PMs often need to pitch ideas and create launch assets quickly without relying entirely on a design team. This tool helps you turn a website into a polished launch video in minutes, which is great for building your portfolio.

section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Studying for PM interviews requires personalized prep to fix your weak spots. This AI study agent tracks where you struggle, offering a practical example of how personalized AI products solve user-specific friction.

section_1_tools.title: Modem
section_1_tools.why_it_matters: Handling customer feedback is a core daily responsibility for any product manager. Modem helps you find, fix, and track customer concerns, giving you a taste of real-world user support and retention workflows.

section_2_ai_news.why_it_matters: Infrastructure cost is a huge factor when PMs price and scope AI features. This massive acquisition shows how big tech companies are racing to optimize AI compute performance.
